text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara finally manages to finish a race in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her excitement is apparent as she gleefully tells me what the wind at the front of the pack feels like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bursting with joy at taking first place, a fire ignites in Haru Urara's heart, and she vows to win even more races.
